Subject: Interview decision matrix & next steps — Ethan Cole (SWE/Platform)

Team —

Thanks for joining the interview loop for Ethan this week. We have a tight window to decide (recruiter is asking for final feedback by EOD Friday). I started a lightweight decision matrix and attached the blank matrix + my initial row; please do two quick things by EOD today:

1) Drop your numeric score (1-5) in the attached scorecard and a 1-2 line justification. Focus on: technical depth, system design, product sense, and culture/impact.
2) If you think we need a follow-up (coding tie-break or manager 1:1), note it in the matrix and volunteer to own scheduling.

Quick context: Ethan interviewed for SWE-Platform. Strong whiteboard coding, some uncertainty on latency-oriented design for KV caching. Hiring manager wants a clear recommendation either hire / no-hire / hire-with-conditions.

Links: feedback doc — https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2bExampleFeedbackDoc (please paste your short notes there as well).

Attachments: scorecard-ethan-cole.pdf (template), decision-matrix-ethan.xlsx

Ben —

Attached my filled scorecard and a short note in the doc. Quick summary:
- Technical depth: 4 — solid algorithms and complexity reasoning.
- System design: 3 — good high-level choices but missed a few caching failure modes and trade-offs for small vs large KV entries.
- Product sense: 4 — pragmatic trade-offs and shipped experience.
- Culture/impact: 5 — team-first, owns end-to-end delivery.

Recommendation: hire-with-conditions — I'd like a 45-min follow-up focused on latency/operationalizing caches (Aditya or Ben could run it) to validate thought process around failure/recovery.

Ben / team —

Scorecard uploaded (attached). Short take: overall 3.5 averaged. Strong coder and pragmatic, but when pushed on cache eviction policies and cross-region consistency he defaulted to vague mitigation strategies rather than concrete trade-offs. That said, this is fixable with onboarding; if we hire, we should flag operational follow-up tasks and pair him in the first sprint.

My vote: lean hire. If we do hire, require a short technical onboarding plan that covers: cache eviction, telemetry for tail latency, and a small ownership area to drive.

[Attachment: scorecard-ethan-cole.pdf]

- Aditya

- On cross-team communication, he described a past post-mortem where he led follow-ups — positive sign.

Subject: Re: Interview decision matrix & next steps — Ethan Cole (SWE/Platform)

Appreciate the quick turns, everyone. Consolidated summary below (pulled from attachments and doc):

- Mina: Technical 4 / Design 3 / Product 4 / Culture 5 — recommend hire-with-conditions (follow-up on caching ops)
- Aditya: Technical 4 / Design 3 / Product 3 / Culture 4 — lean hire, require onboarding plan
- Lauren: Technical 3 / Design 3 / Product 3 / Culture 4 — wants manager 1:1 to probe ownership
- Neha: (uploaded) Technical 3 / Design 2 / Product 4 / Culture 4 — cautious hire (needs more evidence on design depth)

Decision matrix (high level): averaged score = 3.5. Major split is confidence on operational/design depth; product fit and culture are solid.

Proposed next steps (owners):
1) Hire-with-conditions and schedule a 30-min manager call to validate ownership appetite (Owner: Lauren — please confirm if you can take candidate manager 1:1; suggested slot: Fri 11:00-11:30).
2) Technical tie-break session if Lauren sees gaps in the manager call (Owner: Aditya or Mina — 45-min deep-dive on cache eviction and cross-region consistency).
3) If manager call goes well, recruiter to issue offer with a 90-day onboarding plan itemizing the three operational check-ins we require (Owner: Ben / Recruiter).
4) If manager call flags unresolved concerns, we can either run the technical tie-break or decline.

Attachments: consolidated decision-matrix-ethan.xlsx attached. I uploaded the consolidated row to the feedback doc and HubSpot (HS1234567).

Action items: Lauren — please confirm you can do Fri 11:00; Aditya/Mina — block a 45-min slot Friday afternoon in case we need it. Recruiter (cc'd on the candidate thread) will hold Friday open for timing.

Thanks — quick cadence on this will help recruiter and candidate (they're expecting an update by Monday morning).

Ben
